title: Global bond yields soar to multi-decade highs as Middle East turmoil reignites inflation fears
summary_full: Bond yields surged across major markets Tuesday as U.S.-Iran hostilities revived energy and inflation risks, with Japan and U.K. yields at multi-decade highs.
